subject: general
question: 'Ungalil Oruvan' (One Among You) is the autobiography of which of the following chief ministers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M.K. Stalin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **M.K. Stalin** is the current Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.
 
• He assumed office on **7 May 2021**.
 
• M.K. Stalin is the son of the former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, **M. Karunanidhi**.
 
• He is a prominent leader of the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (**DMK**) party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **M.K. Stalin:**

 
 
• M.K. Stalin (Muthuvel Karunanidhi Stalin) was born on 1 March 1953 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• He started his political career with the DMK party and held various positions within the party over the years.
 
• Before becoming the Chief Minister, he served as the Deputy Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu from 2009 to 2011.
 
• Stalin has also held the position of Mayor of Chennai from 1996 to 2002.
 
 
 
• **Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK):**
 
 
• The DMK is a political party in the state of Tamil Nadu and the Union Territory of Puducherry in India.
 
• It was founded by C.N. Annadurai in 1949 as a breakaway faction from the Dravidar Kazhagam.
 
• The party has a strong base among the Tamil population and has been a significant force in Tamil Nadu politics.
 
• The DMK has been involved in various state and national level political activities and has formed the government in Tamil Nadu multiple times.
 
 
 
• **Autobiography:**
 
 
• An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of a person.
 
• It provides insights into the personal and professional life of the author, including their experiences, challenges, and achievements.
 
• Autobiographies are valuable historical documents as they offer first-hand accounts of events and people from the perspective of the author.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister:**
 
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the government in a state in India.
 
• The Chief Minister is elected by the legislative assembly of the state and is appointed by the Governor.
 
• The role of the Chief Minister includes formulating policies, implementing laws, and overseeing the administration of the state government.
 
• The Chief Minister is also responsible for representing the state in various national and international forums.
